H03.note: Converged on direction: AND by default, retaining explicit union and intersection and rejecting unknown modes. This records direction, not unanimous formal approval or implementation uptake. Document the migration for both-lists/no-mode queries.

H13.note: Converged on strict execution validation, including nonce, balance and sender-code checks. Error-code mapping and compatibility migration remain open; client implementations are not harmonized.

H28.note: Historical-state semantics agree on all captured native development builds for trace_call. Erigon fixed the one-transaction-late history boundary in #24056, merged 2026-09-18; the captured v3.6.1 release predates it. The H28 probes use only trace_call and eth_getStorageAt, so they do not cover replay: Besu block replay skips the block’s pre-block system calls (Besu #10953, open), and Erigon’s historical trace_callMany still reads the next block’s system writes; both come from source review and are not yet captured. The stricter Harmonized milestone is still blocked by unrelated H09 failed-frame result-schema errors in the Besu and Nethermind beacon-call responses. This records agreement on the checked block boundary, not complete system-operation coverage or unanimous formal approval.
